check_square_at.obligation: Require source component, target component, F arrow image, G arrow image, left eta_target after F arrow, then right G arrow after eta_source in that exact order. Every missing input returns its exact first Err string. Compare defined target composite values; inequality fails with exact morphism/left/right values, equality succeeds. Shared borrowed table returns exact same Option str values as prior owned tuple lookup, without four temporary key Strings per square.

data_trait_macro_review: DeclaredFiniteNatTrans has public raw name/F/G labels and component map with standard structural Clone/PartialEq/Eq/Debug. ValidatedFiniteNatTrans has private owned raw declaration, both category snapshots and both functor snapshots with the same derives, no serde or mutable constructor/accessor bypass. NaturalTransformation has associated F/G constrained to equal Rust source/target interface types and one required component callback; it does not check naturality or callback purity/termination. NaturalIsomorphism has only three unbounded associated types and carries no isomorphism law. No trait callback is invoked by finite admission. Ordinary format!/derive only, no own arithmetic, float, unsafe, indexing, unwrap/expect/assert or external effect. Standard ownership/map/string/allocator/compiler behavior is explicit trust.
cost_review: Let O_s,M_s be source objects/arrows, C_t target composition rows and K bound map sizes. Public naturality diagnostics build O(C_t) borrowed references once and make two component/map queries plus two table queries per source arrow: O(C_t+M_s log(K+1)) key comparisons, with string-length equality/comparison/format costs explicit. At most one required error string per square. No temporary owned query-key String in the repeated square checks.

Component boundary diagnostics scan O_s objects with up to four borrowed tree lookups and required output messages. Exact component-domain comparison is linear in map/set lengths without temporary collections. Raw constructor/setter own required strings/keys/values; borrowed component/certificate accessors allocate nothing.

Full admission includes one or two complete functor reports, hence their complete category checks and target views, plus component/naturality phases. Full F==G skips a duplicate report only on actual structural equality. Repeated named endpoint failures are retained intentionally. New certificate owns independent category/functor clones only after successful report, as required by its lifetime/API boundary.

Clone/Eq/Debug costs the visited/owned raw data and output bytes. Small target-index construction even on an empty supplied arrow domain remains an explicit O(C_t) setup cost; no work-budget, whole-constructor zero-allocation, capacity/layout compatibility, allocator-totality or benchmark claim.
consumer_review: Local source search resolves finite natural-transformation identity/vertical/horizontal composition to this immutable certificate and its constructor. Generic abstract catalog interfaces and NaturalIsomorphism are separate markers. Three completed contexts reference this source (cat_functor, category validator, functor operations); they keep unchanged own bytes/primary/metrics with explicit preservation of lookup values, diagnostic payload/order, required/public signatures and certificate gating. Open natural-transformation composition consumers are compiled in original category tests but are not automatically graded. Local tfqm/nominal interface identity is distinct from external omega packages.

source_preservation.private_signature_change: check_square_at takes the shared borrowed view instead of the raw owned-key table. It has exactly one production caller, adapted to build one view. No public API or record/trait/derive definition changes.
source_preservation.semantic_argument: BTreeMap<String,String> pair key order equals borrowed str pair order. Shared view copies every immutable key/value association without sorting/filtering and returns exact borrowed values via safe lookup. Existing prerequisite, left/right query order, defined-equality comparison and all Err messages/phase behavior remain unchanged.
